title: Telekinesis | drag | throw/spin | TOOL by DuaKNo
features:
When you execute you gotta wait around 3 seconds till you get the 2 tools
First tool is the telekinesis drag and spin 
And the other is a show ownership 

To change modes you should equip the Spin unachored and on top right corner will be a mode button, by clicking it you're gonna change to new mode

If you're using the sound uanchored tool and you unequip it, you'll still gonna be able to move 

TELEKINESIS - to make the telekinesis without making the unachored fall everytime is that you have to click on the unanchored part and then unequip the tool because if you click again while HOLDING the tool is gonna release the unachored part
